description: This file contains the server-side code-behind for the TheoryExam.aspx page. It manages the loading of theory questions from a database, handles user session validation, submits student answers to the database, and controls exam timing via a countdown timer.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page, handling page load, user interactions, and database operations related to the theoretical exam.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the exam page by loading questions from the database and setting the exam timer based on session data.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the provided course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles the submission of the student's answers, saving responses into multiple database tables, and registering the course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timeout conditions during the exam.
